approved.en: Ecuadorian footballer Jhon Perlaza was banned for eight years after throwing a stone at an assistant referee, showing violence spilling into sport. Fishermen from Ecuador have filed lawsuits against the United States, alleging a drone strike sank their boat near the Galápagos, linking the attack to broader security concerns. The bodies of Ecuadorian construction workers killed in a New York building collapse are being returned to Quito, prompting demands for justice. The UCDP counted two battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.

approved.en: U.S. Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth travelled to Caracas and signed a new military partnership with the interim Venezuelan government, expanding cooperation to target drug trafficking and designating Venezuela a compliant security partner while meeting interim president and Delcy Rodriguez. The United States also launched a Caribbean operation during which a marine died after falling overboard. Venezuela’s former oil minister Machado urged a more drastic overhaul of the oil sector. Two battle-related deaths occurred in 2007, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: U.S. forsvarsminister Pete Hegseth reiste til Caracas og signerte et nytt militært partnerskap med den midlertidige venezuelanske regjeringen, og utvidet samarbeidet for å bekjempe narkotikahandel og erklærte Venezuela som en etterfølgende sikkerhetspartner mens han møtte den midlertidige presidenten og Delcy Rodriguez. USA lanserte også en karibisk operasjon der en marine døde etter å ha falt overbord. Venezuelas tidligere oljeminister Machado oppfordret til en mer drastisk omlegging av oljesektoren. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2007, ifølge UCDP.
